about:
FUEL'D Apparel and Design operates from Idaho Falls, Idaho, serving the broader southeast Idaho region including Rigby, Rexburg, Shelley, Blackfoot, and Pocatello. The company was founded by Tiffanie Franco, who serves as CEO, and Josh Scott, COO, bringing together 17 and 15 years of business ownership experience respectively. Franco also contributes 20 years in design, while Scott adds 12 years in branding. The venture began with a focus on delivering more than average branding solutions for businesses and individuals.

The shop provides in-house decoration and printing services: screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, sublimation, UV printing, and patch application using leather, PVC, and woven materials. It also offers custom graphic and logo design, business printing (cards, notebooks, door hangers, banners), and sources thousands of promotional product options. All production is handled locally with American-made equipment, and the company emphasizes a no-minimum-order policy.

Clients range from local businesses and sports teams to event organizers and individuals. Notable customers include automotive repair shop Fixit 4 You, automotive service provider Grease Monkey, graphics firm Vinyl Edge Graphics, and detailing business EZ Detailing. The company also targets local marketing, political campaigns, and service businesses with its print and promo offerings.

FUEL'D differentiates itself through a combination of no setup fees or minimums, an award-winning design team, typical 2–3 week turnaround with paid rush options down to same-week delivery, and a commitment to quality using American-made equipment. The owners state that quality, consistency, and an easy ordering process are core to their mission.
